events.event_name: CookUnity: The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five Manhattan bodegas: 451 3rd Ave; 266 W 23rd St; 369 Madison Ave; 275 W 4th St; 873 Broadway, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas where eight chefs serve complimentary signature meals, with hot bites, cold meals to go and a bodega-style scratch-off promotion.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary CookUnity chef-made meals and hot bites while supplies last; guests also receive a scratch-off for chances to win additional CookUnity meals or dining experiences.
events.caveats: Current sources agree the event is open to the public with no RSVP requirement published. Meals are while supplies last and lines are expected. Five locations participate simultaneously; this is kept as one underlying event rather than five duplicate event cards.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, Sept. 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Locations: Slice N’ Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam’s Deli, 275 W 4th St; Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway. Arrive before opening if the free meal is the priority.

events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-day Medik8 activation at Sephora SoHo with personalized skincare consultations, product discovery, samples and giveaways; Ariana Madix appears on Sept. 16 under a separate purchase-qualified wristband offer.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary personalized skincare consultations, samples and advertised giveaways; gifts with purchase are separate from the free public experience.
events.caveats: The live Sephora SoHo page lists Medik8 in-store events on both Sept. 16 and Sept. 17 and confirms the store address is 557 Broadway (not 557 West Broadway). The Partiful page confirms the Sept. 17 11 AM–7 PM pop-up and free samples/giveaways. The Ariana Madix meet-and-greet on Sept. 16 requires being among the first 150 eligible customers to purchase two full-size Medik8 products; do not present that celebrity meet as free admission.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 16 public pop-up 12–5:30 PM; Ariana meet 6–8 PM is purchase-qualified. Sept. 17 public pop-up 11 AM–7 PM. Use 557 Broadway for the location.

events.event_name: TRAVELER’S COMPANY CARAVAN 20th Anniversary — Free Admission Days
events.address: Yoseka Land, 58 West St, Brooklyn, NY 11222
events.what_it_is: The free-admission public phase of TRAVELER’S COMPANY's 20th Anniversary Caravan in New York, with an anniversary gallery, Stamp Caravan, limited-edition notebook items and event-exclusive merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the Sept. 18–20 public event, anniversary display and Stamp Caravan is free; limited-edition merchandise is sold separately.
events.caveats: The earlier Sept. 11–12 workshop/timed-entry phase was ticketed and is sold out. The official TRAVELER’S COMPANY update explicitly directs visitors to the Sept. 18–20 free-admission days. Anniversary and event-exclusive merchandise is limited and may sell out.
events.practical_notes: Free public admission Friday–Sunday, Sept. 18–20, 10 AM–7 PM at Yoseka Land. No ticket is needed for these free-admission days.

events.address: The Brant Foundation, 421 E 6th St, New York, NY 10009
events.what_it_is: A three-day immersive flat-pack wooden forest by Cj Hendry and Sulwhasoo, inspired by the hidden garden at the House of Sulwhasoo in Seoul.
events.what_is_free: Public entry to the immersive installation is advertised as open to the public; no paid ticket or purchase requirement is published for Sept. 18–20.
events.caveats: Cj Hendry's official exhibition calendar confirms Secret Garden at the Brant Foundation Sept. 18–20. Current NYC event listings publish public hours as 10 AM–6 PM daily and describe it as open to the public. No RSVP or approval requirement was found in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Friday–Sunday, Sept. 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM at The Brant Foundation, 421 E 6th St. This is separate from Hendry's Flower Market at Rockefeller Center the following week.
